baseline_comparison.attribution: Pre-existing environmental/runtime-contract failures: three HealthPayload/Pydantic schema failures and one Windows Python 3.14 subprocess-handle failure.

shared_invariant: Lock ownership/reclamation authority must come from the granting authority or trustworthy grantor-observable mechanism; PID/OpenProcess metadata may be diagnostic, never authoritative.
shared_regression_recipe: First acquisition and contention while a real grant is held.
Readable diagnostic metadata without authority semantics.
Dead, stale, reused, or unrelated PID metadata cannot block a legitimate acquisition.
Stale metadata cannot authorize reclaim of an active grant.
No liveness-only lock decision or destructive marker unlink.

target_specific_differences.feature-phone-clank: Dataclass RunLock classmethod surface with path argument and historical stale_after_hours API retained but ignored; diagnostic marker persists after release.
target_specific_differences.tablet-clank: SoakLock instance/context-manager surface plus campaign SoakLock.inspect probe; canonical preflight reports active from kernel contention and stale only for readable unheld metadata.

known_evidence_admission.scope: Only STD-OPS-COM-004 conformance findings for these two target revisions are admitted.

first_validated_shared_fleet_remediation.pattern: One authority invariant, two independent target integrations, shared adversarial regression shape, no Watch code cargo-culting.

guardrails.next_wave: OPS-COM-003 qualification provenance/reset remediation across its six affected Clanks.
